title: 2011 Irkutsk mass UFO sighting

tellings.quote: You see, back in 2011, Russian National Channel 1 aired a report about a supposed mass UFO sighting in the Irkutsk Oblast, a region in Southeastern Siberia.

plain: In 2011 Russia's main state TV station, Channel 1, aired a report about a supposed mass UFO sighting in Irkutsk Oblast, a region in southeastern Siberia, where many people are said to have seen the same thing. Michels tells this himself from that broadcast, naming Nelly Stepanovna and Sergey Yazev as he does, and brings it up in an episode about strange three-fingered bodies found in Peru.
